limitations: Interactor read latencies on this shared VM are higher than the previous workstation's recorded values; local measurements, not capacity claims.
Live hosted docs-retrieval contracts (15) and shipped-model behavior were not exercised; paid calls not authorized.
Trial/grace lifecycle jobs do not remove a pending member's protected authorization task (needs an administrator update).
Main's operator platform-access test can wait on a User table lock under parallel load; #196 classifier tests require AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY to be empty.
Unreachable terminology approval rule kept for historical transcript labels.
Importer refuses when Production has an extension unavailable locally (safe failure before export).
Vercel preview database of this branch may hold the retired migration chain and needs a reset before the preview deploys.
